verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS compliance and security platform that ships AI features, including Fieldwork AI agents and an MCP server, so a buyer could fairly ask about AI-training data controls. The evidence pack contains no documented opt-out, no no-training commitment, and no policy on whether customer data is used to train models. Adjacent items, such as the GitHub integration not needing repository contents and scoped access via roles and service keys, are access controls rather than training-use controls and earn no credit.
